body:
It will be nice to add csv file with requirements directly to source directory, not only as downladable assets. We want to have source CSV file as source for architecture by targeting it.

PS: I want to translate to czech language. I am blind and I love MD, but, in this case, CSV file will be my first source for our translation, rather tan MD files.

comments.body:
We upload the output formats when we have a new release so hopefully there will be a reference CSV file for version 5.0 in the next few weeks.

For now, there is still the 4.0.3 version here:
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/docs_en/OWASP%20Application%20Security%20Verification%20Standard%204.0.3-en.csv

Yes, I know. But for many purposes, CSV may be useful in source directory too.

>Yes, I know. But for many purposes, CSV may be useful in source directory too.

I don't think I understand. Would a similar link to this but for version 5.0 not help? https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS/blob/master/4.0/docs_en/OWASP%20Application%20Security%20Verification%20Standard%204.0.3-en.csv

The CSV file is linked from the readme in the GitHub page. I don't think it can be easier and helpful than that.
https://github.com/OWASP/ASVS

Where the generated files are stored in the folder tree does not matter here too much. Everything can not be stored in the repository root folder, and the location for the generated files is following the intended structure.

> PS: I want to translate to czech language. I am blind and I love MD, but, in this case, CSV file will be my first source for our translation, rather tan MD files.

If we talk about the translations shared by the ASVS repository, those must be translated into the Markdown format. Although for the v5.0 release, I prefer to get translation in a structured format (e.g., JSON), but this is another and separate topic.

For me, there is no problem to solve or action to make from this issue and it can be closed.

I am going to leave this open as I'd like to understand more about the need here.

> If we talk about the translations shared by the ASVS repository, those must be translated into the Markdown format.

For context, we need .MD so that we can generate the other output formats.  Also, the CSV format does not contain the surrounding texts which would also need to be translated.

labels.description: This issue does not block 5.0 so if it gets addressed then great, if not then fine.
